title: Sorting Objects and Talking About Data
seo_title: Grade R Sorting and Data Worksheets with Answers (CAPS Maths)
standard_code: Grade R: Collect, sort and talk about data
standard_text: Collect and sort everyday physical objects; represent sorted collections by drawing; discuss and report on sorted collections of objects (how they were sorted and why).
meta_desc: Free CAPS Grade R maths worksheets: sorting objects by colour, shape and size, counting groups, the most and the odd one out. 100 questions with pictures and memos.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Sort by one rule: colour, shape or size.
  • Count each group.
  • The group with the biggest number has the most.
  • Say how you sorted.

Examples

Example

Sort the buttons by colour: 4 red, 2 blue

4 is more than 2

Answer: red has more

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Two rulesUse one rule at a time.
Counting twiceCross off each one.
Big objectMost means the biggest number.
